records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Sales of Grand Theft Auto products generated 14.7% of our net revenue for the three months ended June 30, 2025.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended June 30, 2025, Net Bookings increased as compared to the prior year period.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase was primarily due to an increase in Net Bookings from our NBA 2K franchise and Color Block Jam, which released in November 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Further, as a result of the platform fees associated with online game sales, our mobile net revenue generally generates a lower gross margin percentage than our Console or PC revenue.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended June 30, 2025, net revenue increased by $165.6 as compared to the prior year period.
